description: PumpCheck: what can go wrong with a memecoin, as of now, on Solana, Base and Robinhood Chain. POST /v1/check with 1 to 10 tokens [{chain, address}]. Each check names its result (pass, fail, warn, unknown, not_available), method (definitive or heuristic), source (live or stored) and the block or slot read; unknown is never counted as a pass. Solana: mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions and transfer hooks, metadata mutability, Pump.fun curve state, creator holding, LP burn. Base and Robinhood Chain: proxy and owner, privileged functions, a simulated buy and sell for honeypot and taxes (an eth_call with state overrides; nothing is deployed or signed), LP burn, holders and deployer, early-buyer share; Pons and Uniswap v2/v3/v4 on Robinhood Chain. One verdict (ok, caution, danger, unknown) from the checks that ran, with plain-language flags. POST /v1/recent is a screening feed from the store. Every response is a JSON object. Not financial advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/check and /v1/recent with a JSON body, plus GET /v1/version, /healthz, /v1/capabilities, /v1/openapi.json. Every response is a JSON object, including errors (which carry an 'error' field); token names are escaped against gateway phrases.

specs.notes: The same document is served by the backend at GET /v1/openapi.json.

serving.backend: The pump-check container (Node 22, SQLite store on a volume; built from github.com/TheFeloniousMonk/portal-services, pump-check/backend) behind the HA RelayMiner. It ingests new pools from DexPaprika every 2 minutes on a rolling 30-day credit ledger, precomputes each token through Pocket's public RPC (failing over to two public endpoints per chain only for request-time reads), and answers checks from the store plus live re-reads. Each supplier sets its own free DexPaprika key and Blockscout PRO API key in the app's Service settings; without them it serves with less coverage. Outbound HTTPS to the RPC endpoints, api.dexpaprika.com and api.blockscout.com.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service.
Readiness: an ingest completed in the last 10 minutes and at least one chain's RPC answers.
Functional probe: USDC's freeze authority, read live through Solana RPC. Stable, and proves a real chain read.

serving.notes: A check of 10 tokens answers within about 11 s. Gateway operators: type passthrough, rpc_types ["rest"], relay_timeout at least 15s; see sage-service.yaml in the service repository.
